risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and quantitatively detailed, with favorable same-store sales and improved restaurant-level cost ratios, but it acknowledges commodity inflation, macroeconomic challenges, and reliance on continued sales growth. Forward-looking statements are moderately optimistic yet dependent on pricing, product mix, operating leverage, and other uncertain factors. The excerpt also contains dense boilerplate accounting language and an apparent percentage inconsistency in the SG&A discussion.
